real_arithmetic_scope: The C2 theorems concern a real-valued smooth model on the full parameter box. Quantized storage, floating-point arithmetic, nondifferentiable routing and stochastic decoding are not automatically covered.
additional_condition: Suppose the actual implemented logits at the individual donor and composed model each differ in infinity norm by at most nu from the corresponding ideal logits, including composition/storage rounding and evaluation arithmetic. Then actual donor-to-mixture logit drift is at most eta_j+2*nu.
implemented_margin_certificate: If the actual donor's unique top-two logit margin exceeds 2*(eta_j+2*nu), its argmax is preserved in the actual composed model. Deterministic sequence preservation still requires this condition at every donor prefix with identical decoding and stop policies.
weight_rounding: A parameter rounding bound does not itself imply a logit bound. It requires a verified model sensitivity bound on the relevant parameter region, or a directly bounded output error. Nonlinear feature-to-logit transfer likewise needs its output-map assumptions.
